title: QuestionsResponse
description: POST /next_question: the next follow-up. Question text and cards are fixed templates, never written by an LLM. Each card carries a `patch`: the Needs fields to set when the buyer taps it.

done.description: True when nothing more needs asking: show the results.

kind.description: required: a field the engine cannot work without. optional: asked only because the answer would change the shortlist. none: done.

why.description: One plain sentence on why we ask.

example.description: An example of a typed answer.

patch.description: Needs fields to set. May be empty (for example 'Not sure' on an optional question).

helper.description: A small calculator the page can offer when the buyer does not know the number. Its assumptions are shown on screen and the buyer confirms the result.

can_show_results.description: True once budget, seats and daily km are known (home charging may be 'unsure').
